book.name: Lɛme
book.title: Ŋwa wu Lɛme chi booŋ ba ntuŋ ba Jiso

content: Anania bɛ Safɛla
Muh mu wù ba gɛ̀ tɛŋe lɛ Anania bɛ kwɛɛ wu Safɛla gɛ̀ gesɛ tɛ kijusɛ.
Bɛ kwɛɛ seesɛ bo gade bige biyu, wu mo wu jo kimbɛge wu gɛɛŋ wu nya chiaaŋ yi booŋ ba ntuŋ ba Jiso le.
No wu nya noo, Bita biih wu le lɛ, “Anania, ge la fɛ wo chinɛ Sataŋ lee a fitele fiuŋ le wu gê lɛ wo mbîaŋ chimbiaŋ fɛ Kiyo ki Yuude le, wo mo wo gade bige bì wo gese kijusɛ yu?
Fɛ wo chi bee ki wo gêsɛ kijusɛ kinɛ gɛ chi bee kuŋ gɛ? Wo doo wo gesɛ bige nyume tɛ biuŋ gɛ? Wo ge nɛɛ fɛ wo ge kfuu chi finɛ fiɛɛ? Wo baaŋ mbiaŋ gɛ nyu bɛ bamii gɛ, wo mbiane nyu fɛ Nyo le.”
Kimimia no Anania yu jɛmɛ wunɛ noo, wu mo wu gwe wu kwe. Bamii bachii bo gɛ̀ yu saaka wuyu faaŋ baaŋ.
Chuu yi bamii to yi banyɛ wu a nju le, bo jo wu bo bu bɛ wu bo gɛɛŋ bo jiiyɛ.
Ajiŋ njɛ juu bataŋ batɛde, kwɛɛ lee, wu kee gɛ̀ fiɛɛ fì be kooshɛ bɛ jwɛɛŋ gɛ.
Bita biih wu le lɛ, “Gɛh sɛ̂ɛŋ mɛ, binɛ le bige bichii bì bena jwɛɛŋ be gesɛ kijusɛ kɛɛ yu?” Wu chvuu lɛ, “Ɛɛŋ, le bi nɛ bichii.”

Bita ka wu biih wu le lɛ, “Bena jwɛɛŋ ge nɛɛ fɛ bɛŋ seesɛ ki bɛŋ môŋ Kiyo ki Tada lɛ? Yêgɛ yû, mɛɛse nchiŋ yi bamii ba gɛnɛ ki bo jiiyɛ jwɛɛŋ le wa a yeh fwɛɛŋ, bo lé bo lêe bo tûu tɛ wo bo bû bɛ wo bo gɛ̂ɛŋ bo jîiyɛ.”
No Bita jɛmɛ noo, kimimia Safɛla mo wu gwe a wu jii wu kwe. Chuu yi bamii baa doo bo lee bo yɛŋ wù nyu wu kwe wa, bo mo bo tuu wu bo bu bɛ wu bo gɛɛŋ bo jiiyɛ mbebe jwɛɛŋ le.
Kintaashɛ ki bamii ba mbɛmɛ kichii mo bamii bachii ba gɛ̀ yu saaka wuyu faaŋ baaŋ.
Mwɛɛ mù duunyi bvuŋga bvu Nyobɛ mwɛɛ mu de yì yunɛ
Booŋ ba ntuŋ ba Jiso tu bo gee mwɛɛ mù duunyi bvuŋga bvu Nyo bɛ mwɛɛ mù duude mu de yì yunɛ a bamii ntɛnɛɛ. Bamii ba mbɛmɛ bachii gɛ̀ taashi fɛ Kibuu ki Salamoŋ le fɛ yeh yi kintanyɛ le.
Gɛ muh wu nchɛ gɛ̀ mone ki wu tâashi bɛ bo gɛ. Geenɛ bamii tu bo bɛɛŋse bo chuule.
Bilɛŋsɛ bɛ bikɛse ba duude ba gɛ̀ leesɛ muntele yi Tada le, tu bo taade fɛ ŋgoo yiboo le.
Mwɛɛ mù booŋ ba ntuŋ ba Jiso gɛ̀ gee, ge bamii tuude bamii ba binchɛŋ bo giŋse mbebe jé le yi binta le mo yi bijinɛ le, lɛ sege Bita doo wu fede, mo nyu gɛh kinjiinyi ke ki gwe yi muh le.
Binchvu bi bamii jade bilaantɛŋ bi mbebe Yɛlusalɛm le bi too bɛ bamii ba binchɛŋ mo ba kɛme biyo bì yiide ye yi boo le, ba fɛde bo bachii bo tɛɛme.
Ba ghɛge booŋ ba ntuŋ ba Jiso
Kikwɛɛ ki bachiji kintanyɛ bɛ ŋgoo ye yì gɛ̀ bee Basadushii gɛ̀ ja bo kɛ bo tu bo ghɛge booŋ ba ntuŋ ba Jiso,
bo mo bo tuŋ bamii bo gɛɛŋ bo koo bo, ba faa yeh yi ncha le.
Geenɛ, antaŋ nchɛndaa wu Tada gɛ̀ gwenyɛ de yi fwese yi yeh yi ncha wu bvusɛ bo. No wu bvuse bo, wu mo wu jɛmɛ lɛ,
“Bɛŋ gɛ̂ɛŋ yeh yi kintanyɛ le kibɛɛ, bɛŋ gɛ̂ɛŋ bɛŋ lɛ̂ɛŋ bɛŋ fêeji fiɛɛ fichii bamii le kune kinche kifɛŋ kinɛ.”

No bo yu noo, bo mo bo gɛɛŋ. Akfuuŋ gɛ̀ doo a yuude, bo lee fɛ yeh yi kintanyɛ le, bo mo bo kɛ bo tu bo yɛyi bamii. Gɛh kife kiyu le, kikwɛɛ ki bachiji kintanyɛ bɛ bamii be ba ŋgoo, bo kuŋ bamii ba Ishwala ba sage woŋ bachii bɛ bo shii, bo mo bo tuŋ bamii ba nchi ki bo gɛɛŋ yeh yi ncha le, bo gɛɛŋ bo to bɛ booŋ ba ntuŋ ba Jiso.
Bo gɛɛŋ bo bu fo bo gooŋ bo sɛŋ bo mo bo tu jiŋ bo sɛɛŋ lɛ,
“Bee le be gɛɛŋ be bu fɛ yeh yi ncha le, bee yɛŋ de yi fwese nyu ba faa chuule bamii ba nchi lɛme fo bo chiɛɛne. Bee doo be gwenyɛ yeh bee lee bee baaŋ yɛŋ gɛ muh le yu gɛ.”
Kikwɛɛ ki bamii ba nchi ba gɛ̀ chiɛɛne yeh yi kintanyɛ bɛ bachiji kintanyɛ ba baaŋ baaŋ yu noo, fi fuuŋsɛ bo, bo tu bo ghaade laa bo lé bo gê bo tû faaŋ bɛ finɛ fiɛɛ lɛ.
Muh ja wu lee wu jɛmɛ bo le lɛ, “Bɛŋ yû, bamii baa ba bɛŋ chi baŋ yeh yi ncha le, bo lɛme wa fɛ yeh yi kintanyɛ le bo yɛyi bamii.”

No bo yu noo, kikwɛɛ ki bamii ba nchi, bɛ ŋgoo ye mo bo bu bo gɛɛŋ bo jo bo, bo tu bo too bɛ bo. Geenɛ, bo gɛ̀ baaŋ jo gɛ bo bo kaaŋ lo bo gɛ, nje bo, bamii ba nchi baa gɛ̀ faane lɛ bamii baa le bo tûmɛ bo bɛ ata.
Bo to bɛ booŋ ba ntuŋ ba Jiso, bo lee bɛ bo, bo lɛɛŋ fwe a bamii ba sage woŋ. Kikwɛɛ ki bachiji kintanyɛ biide bo mwɛɛ wu duu lɛ,

“Bee le be moŋ wa ki be lejɛ lo lɛ keefɛ bɛŋ ka bɛŋ môŋ bɛŋ yɛ̂yɛ muh kune jee chi muh wunɛ gɛ. Geenɛ, bɛŋ yɛ̂ŋ fiɛɛ fì bɛŋ moŋ! Bɛŋ le bɛŋ ge wa n'yɛyɛ wene saaŋe Yɛlusalɛm achii. Bɛŋ goone ki bɛŋ gê fi dûunyi lɛ bee kee fiɛɛ fɛ kwe ye le.”
Bita bɛ ŋgoo yi booŋ ba ntuŋ ba Jiso chvuu lɛ, “Bee kɛme ki be yû nyu Nyo le, nyume gɛ a muh le gɛ.
Bɛŋ gɛ̀ ta Jiso yi kintaaŋ le wu kwe. Nyo wu bachiji chiji wese bvusɛ wu yi kwe le,
wu bɛɛŋsɛ wu, wu shiishɛ wu a kibo ke kinchiɛɛŋ le, lɛ wu nyûme Chiji kikwɛɛ mo Mbvusɛ, fi le lɛ bamii ba Ishwala kûsɛ muntele muboo, wu wù Nyo lɛ̂ɛshɛ bimbefɛ biboo.
Bee le be yɛŋ mwɛɛ munɛ le, bee mo be tu be sɛŋe bamii le, Kiyo ki Yuude kì Nyo nyaa bamii ba yuge wu le ki toone tɛ lɛ mwɛɛ munɛ le nchiɛɛŋ.”
No bamii ba gɛ̀ sage woŋ yu njɛmɛ wunɛ noo, muntele bɛde lo bo. Bo mo bo goone ki bo yuuyɛ booŋ ba ntuŋ ba Jiso.

Geenɛ, muh mu ŋgoo yi bamii ba gɛ̀ sage woŋ le, wù jee che gɛ̀ bee Gamala, nyu muh wu Bafalashii ka nyu muh wù duunyi banchi ba Nyo, bamii bachii ŋgvuune wu chuule wu ja we. No wu ja we, wu jɛmɛ bo le lɛ bo ya bo bvusɛ booŋ ba ntuŋ ba Jiso akfuuŋ.
Wu shɛɛ wu jɛmɛ bamii ba gɛ̀ sage woŋ le lɛ, “Bamii ba Ishwala, bɛŋ jô wɛɛ bɛ fiɛɛ fì bɛŋ goone ki bɛŋ gê bɛ bamii banɛ.

Bɛŋ kwâjɛ lɛ gɛ̀ bee kife kimi le, muh mu ja fɛnɛ ba tɛŋe lɛ Tioda, wu tu wu duunyi lɛ wu le muh wù baaŋ. Bamii banyɛ a wu jiŋ njɛ gii yinɛh. Ba gɛ̀ yuuyɛ wu ŋgoo ye saaŋe, fiɛɛ fì wu gɛ̀ too bɛ fi laayɛ achiji.
Ajiŋ ayu, muh mu ka wu ja kife kì ba gɛ̀ taŋe bamii ba tɛŋe lɛ Juda, nyu muh wu Galalee. Wu chii bamii wesee a wu jiŋ. Ba gɛ̀ yuuyɛ tɛ wu, ŋgoo ye saaŋe.
Yi finɛ le, ntêefe bɛŋ lɛ keefɛ bɛŋ gê fiɛɛ bɛ bamii banɛ gɛ. Bɛŋ chînɛ je yiboo le! Finɛ le lɛ fiɛɛ fì bo too bɛ fi finɛ bo ka yɛyi bamii yu finɛ nɛ kɛ muh wu wuŋ, tu fi le fi laayɛ achiji.
Nɛ fi le lɛ fiɛɛ fiyu kɛ Nyo, tu gɛ taŋlo bɛŋ ge bɛŋ so bo gɛ. Bɛŋ yɛ̂nɛ, keefɛ fi jâ fi bû lɛ bɛŋ juu nyu bɛ Nyo.”

No Gamala jɛmɛ noo, bamii ba gɛ̀ sage woŋ bo yu nteefe ye, bo kaasɛ bo tɛɛŋ booŋ ba ntuŋ ba Jiso bo lee. No bo lese noo, bo taaŋ bo, bo chiisɛ lo lɛ keefɛ bo ka bo môŋ lo bo yɛ̂yɛ muh kune jee chi Jiso gɛ, bo mo bo chinɛ bo le lɛ bo gɛ̂ɛne.
No bo bu yu bo ja bo gɛɛne fiboo bo yuge nyu njoŋ lɛ bo le bo kojɛ bamii ba, ba choose bo nje jee chi Jiso.
Lɛ bo gɛɛŋ noo, bo ka bo tu bo yɛyi bamii aju achii fɛ yeh yi kintanyɛ le mo ala le, bo feeji saaka wù joŋe wu Jiso, lɛ Jiso le Mbvusɛ wù Nyo gɛ̀ ka.
